subTitle: The questions we hear most about our cloth, shipping, and how we work with artisans.

faqs.question: Will the colour of my cloth match the photo exactly?
faqs.answer: Not always, and that is by design. Natural dyes and handweaving make every piece slightly different in tone and motif. We photograph each production batch so the variation stays within a natural range.

faqs.question: How do I wash naturally dyed woven cloth?
faqs.answer: Hand wash in cold water with a mild, bleach-free soap, avoid wringing it hard, and dry it in the shade. The full guide is on our Care Guide page.

faqs.question: How long does a custom order take?
faqs.answer: Usually 4–8 weeks, depending on size and the complexity of the motif. We send a motif sketch and colour samples for your approval before the artisans start weaving.

faqs.question: Does Tenun Lestari ship internationally?
faqs.answer: We currently ship across Indonesia and to several Southeast Asian countries. Shipping costs and estimated delivery times appear before payment (the shop is not active in this demo).

faqs.question: How do we know artisans are paid fairly?
faqs.answer: Per-piece prices are agreed with each weaving group before production and partly paid up front. We publish a yearly summary of prices, volumes and training programmes (sample content for this demo).

faqs.question: Can damaged cloth be repaired?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send your Tenun Lestari cloth to our studio; pulled threads, fraying edges or light stains are handled by artisans who know the weaving technique.
